sources.title: GGUF-Models (GGUF) - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Our goal is to simplify the process of searching for and exchanging quantized models in GGUF format, as well as to create a space for efficient exchange and access to the models you need

sources.title: GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: We're on a journey to advance and democratize artificial intelligence through open source and open science.

sources.title: GGUF Model Discovery - Browse & Download AI Models
sources.snippet: Discover and download GGUF format AI models. Browse and direct download thousands of quantized AI models with detailed information, download counts, and direct links.

sources.title: GGUF格式开源模型大全：轻量级模型资源合集
sources.snippet: 本页面汇聚超200个经过社区精选验证的GGUF格式开源中小模型。模型参数量小，推理速度快，资源占用低，适用于NLP、CV等多领域。兼容PyTorch、TensorFlow等多种框架，支持本地及移动端部署。可一键下载，持续更新，快来挑选适合您的模型!
